title: The part of school that does not appear on the report card
lead: Confidence, responsibility and judgement are not by-products of a good education. They are taught, and we teach them on purpose.

pillars.title: Voice & stage
pillars.description: Every student performs. Annual plays, patriotic singing, elocution and assembly duty give each child repeated, low-stakes practice at standing in front of people — long before it matters.

pillars.title: Responsibility
pillars.description: Class monitors, house duties, event roles and junior mentoring. Students are given tasks that other people genuinely depend on being done.

pillars.title: Environment & service
pillars.description: Plantation drives, campus green spaces and community days. Environmental responsibility is treated as a habit rather than a topic.

pillars.title: Career guidance
pillars.description: Structured counselling for senior students: stream implications, entrance routes, application timelines and honest conversations about aptitude.

pillars.title: Study skills
pillars.description: Note-making, revision planning, time management and examination technique taught explicitly from the middle school upward.

pillars.title: Wellbeing
pillars.description: Attentive class teachers, a supervised canteen, an open door for parents, and staff who are expected to notice when something has changed.

programmes.title: Annual cultural programme
programmes.description: Full-scale productions rehearsed and staged by students across all four sections — recent titles include Aasman Se Gira, Choo Manter and Laher Badlav Ki.

programmes.title: Science & tour exhibitions
programmes.description: Students design, build and present working models and study-tour findings to parents and visiting schools.

programmes.title: Robotics workshops
programmes.description: Practical sessions for high school classes covering sensing, control and simple autonomous behaviour.

programmes.title: Inter-school competition
programmes.description: Entries in sport, singing, elocution and quiz — including state-level representation in throwball.

programmes.title: Festival & national days
programmes.description: Diwali, Christmas, Independence Day, Republic Day and Teachers' Day marked across the whole school.

programmes.title: Study tours
programmes.description: Supervised educational visits that connect the syllabus to places, industries and institutions in and around Nagpur.
